associations.note: The entry is printed under its own heading 'Patamea' in the Savai‘i section, between Lealatele and Sale‘aula. Not yet confirmed by Patamea or a second source.

content.summary: The fa‘alupega of Patamea as printed in the 1981 edition, with its malae-fono, maota, igoa-ipu and sa‘otama‘ita‘i.
content.transcription:
Patamea
Tulouna a oe le Pule to i Malaeola, ma Gafuaga
… oe le Faleaana
… lau Afioga a Lauago
MALAE-FONO
Gafuaga
MAOTA O ALII
Lauago: Faletogō
O IGOA-IPU A ALII
Lauago: Taua‘itao
SA‘OTAMA‘ITA‘I
Lauago: Sinanuu

provenance.method: Read from the page image of Te Papa's digitised copy (PDF page 31) and checked against OCR. Line breaks follow the printed page; '…' marks the repeated opening words.

research.notes: Transcription checked against the page image by Lisa Stephan on 16 Oct 2026. Diacritics follow the printed page where legible.
